# Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Global Paid Social & Mobile UA
Remote - USAJob ID#: P75940

󰝲

If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here.

As Performance Marketing Manager, Global, you'll own our performance marketing program, managing hundreds of millions in ad spend across paid social and mobile channels to drive new user acquisition at or above ROI targets.

**What you'll do:**

- Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets.
- Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets.
- Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership.

- A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment
- Proven track record owning large-scale paid social and mobile UA budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets.
- Analytical and experimentation mindset; comfortable with spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau, Superset) to build and launch tests, interpret results, and make data-grounded decisions.
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, able to synthesize complex performance narratives and influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations.
- Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

$170,765—$200,900 USD

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Global Paid Social & Mobile UA

Remote - USAJob ID#: P75940

[Apply now](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_app?token=8192485&for=coinbase&gh_jid=8192485)

󰝲

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At [Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/?utm_campaign=mt_o_m_w_m_m__coi_0_jd-onchain&utm_source=coinbase), we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” [learn more about working at Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/careers).

Our Growth Marketing team within the [Consumer & Business](https://www.coinbase.com/careers/product-groups) group scales Coinbase's customer base and revenue through data-driven, full-funnel acquisition strategies across paid channels globally. As Performance Marketing Manager, Global, you'll own our performance marketing program, managing hundreds of millions in ad spend across paid social and mobile channels to drive new user acquisition at or above ROI targets.

**What you'll do:**

- Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets.
- Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets.
- Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and mobile measurement frameworks (MMM, SKAN, MMP-based) that connect paid social and mobile UA performance to downstream business outcomes.
- Lead platform relationships with ad platforms and mobile measurement partners, aligning on betas, measurement approaches, and joint growth plans to unlock new capabilities.
- Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams.

**Required skills and experience:**

- A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment
- Proven track record owning large-scale paid social and mobile UA budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets.
- Strong technical aptitude and experience leveraging LLMs, no-code/low-code platforms, and automation tools (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make, Retool) to prototype custom agents and AI-driven workflows that accelerate growth experimentation, optimize operational efficiency, and scale hyper-targeted paid social and mobile campaigns
- Analytical and experimentation mindset; comfortable with spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau, Superset) to build and launch tests, interpret results, and make data-grounded decisions.
- Deep experience with mobile measurement and privacy-aware execution, including SKAN, mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), event strategy, and incrementality testing across app and web
- B2C experience required; fintech, crypto, or high-consideration consumer financial products strongly preferred.
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, able to synthesize complex performance narratives and influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations.
- Highly organized with strong project management skills; able to manage multiple geographies, campaigns, tests, and priorities in parallel while maintaining execution quality
- Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

**Pay Transparency Notice:** Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):

$170,765—$200,900 USD

- _**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws._

- _**Accommodations:** If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations\[at\]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? [Click here](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/screen-reader/kgejglhpjiefppelpmljglcjbhoiplfn) to download a free compatible screen reader and view the [tutorial](http://www.chromevox.com/tutorial/)._
- _**Data Privacy & Arbitration:** By submitting your application, you agree to our [Candidate Privacy Notice](https://www.coinbase.com/legal/applicant_privacy_notice). US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to [Arbitration of Disputes](https://www.coinbase.com/legal/application-arbitration-agreement)._

[Apply now](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_app?token=8192485&for=coinbase&gh_jid=8192485)

- The option of getting paid in digital currency

class="content-intro"><p>Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At <a href="https://www.coinbase.com/?utm_campaign=mt_o_m_w_m_m__coi_0_jd-onchain&utm_source=coinbase">Coinbase</a>, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” <a href="https://www.coinbase.com/careers">learn more about working at Coinbase</a>.</p></div><p>Our Growth Marketing team within the <a href="https://www.coinbase.com/careers/product-groups">Consumer & Business</a> group scales Coinbase's customer base and revenue through data-driven, full-funnel acquisition strategies across paid channels globally. As Performance Marketing Manager, Global, you'll own our performance marketing program, managing hundreds of millions in ad spend across paid social and mobile channels to drive new user acquisition at or above ROI targets.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets.</li>
<li>Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets.</li>
<li>Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and mobile measurement frameworks (MMM, SKAN, MMP-based) that connect paid social and mobile UA performance to downstream business outcomes.</li>
<li>Lead platform relationships with ad platforms and mobile measurement partners, aligning on betas, measurement approaches, and joint growth plans to unlock new capabilities.</li>
<li>Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership.</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Required skills and experience:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment</li>
<li>Proven track record owning large-scale paid social and mobile UA budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets.</li>
<li>Strong technical aptitude and experience leveraging LLMs, no-code/low-code platforms, and automation tools (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make, Retool) to prototype custom agents and AI-driven workflows that accelerate growth experimentation, optimize operational efficiency, and scale hyper-targeted paid social and mobile campaigns</li>
<li>Analytical and experimentation mindset; comfortable with spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau, Superset) to build and launch tests, interpret results, and make data-grounded decisions.</li>
<li>Deep experience with mobile measurement and privacy-aware execution, including SKAN, mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), event strategy, and incrementality testing across app and web</li>
<li>B2C experience required; fintech, crypto, or high-consideration consumer financial products strongly preferred.</li>
<li>Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, able to synthesize complex performance narratives and influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations.</li>
<li>Highly organized with strong project management skills; able to manage multiple geographies, campaigns, tests, and priorities in parallel while maintaining execution quality</li>
<li>Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency Notice:</strong><strong><em> </em></strong>Base salary varies by location (see range below). # Performance Marketing Manager (Growth & Lifecycle) - Remote

United States

Apply

**About LumiMeds**

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

### Location: Remote

### **About the Role**

You will own paid acquisition across major ad platforms while improving conversion rates and lifecycle performance. You will work closely with the Creative Director, product, and leadership to scale acquisition efficiently while maintaining compliance with platform and healthcare regulations.

You are not responsible for graphic design — but you must drive testing strategy and performance optimization.

* * *

## **What You’ll Own**

**1\. Paid Acquisition (Core Responsibility)**

Own strategy, execution, and optimization across:

- Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube)
- Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram)
- Reddit Ads
- Tiktok Ads
- Microsoft Ads (Bing)
- App Lovin
- Ad Roll

Responsibilities:

- Manage and scale paid budgets efficiently
- Optimize CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, and LTV
- Conduct structured A/B testing across copy,creatives, offers, audiences, and funnels
- Adjust bidding strategies and campaign structure based on data
- Identify scaling opportunities without increasing risk exposure

You must understand advertising restrictions related to healthcare, medical claims, and regulated products.

**2\. Landing Page & Funnel Optimization (CRO)**

- Improve and test multiple funnels
- Recommend landing page structure improvements
- Suggest pricing tests, bundling experiments, and offer adjustments
- Propose creative test variations to the Creative Director
- Improve checkout and subscription flow performance

_Important: You do not design visuals, but you drive performance testing strategy._

**3\. Compliance & Platform Policy Awareness**

- ​​Ensure campaigns comply with platform ad policies (Google, Meta, etc.)
- Understand regulated marketing limitations (medical claims, disclaimers)
- Partner with internal stakeholders to prevent account flags or shutdown risk
- Maintain a risk-aware scaling strategy

### **4\. Lifecycle & Retention (Critical Gap to Build)**

Own and build our lifecycle marketing engine:

- SMS automation
- Email automation
- Abandoned cart flows
- Post-purchase sequences
- Subscription retention campaigns
- Win-back flows

Goals:

- Increase LTV
- Improve retention rates
- Reduce churn
- Personalize messaging based on behavior

Experience with Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms preferred.

### **5\. Analytics & Attribution**

- Build reporting dashboards

Performance Marketing Manager (Growth & Lifecycle) - Remote

United States

About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Location: Remote 

About the Role

You will own paid acquisition across major ad platforms while improving conversion rates and lifecycle performance. You will work closely with the Creative Director, product, and leadership to scale acquisition efficiently while maintaining compliance with platform and healthcare regulations.

You are not responsible for graphic design — but you must drive testing strategy and performance optimization.

What You’ll Own

1. Paid Acquisition (Core Responsibility)

Own strategy, execution, and optimization across:

  • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube)
  • Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram)
  • Reddit Ads
  • Tiktok Ads
  • Microsoft Ads (Bing)
  • App Lovin
  • Ad Roll

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and scale paid budgets efficiently
  • Optimize CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, and LTV
  • Conduct structured A/B testing across copy,creatives, offers, audiences, and funnels
  • Adjust bidding strategies and campaign structure based on data
  • Identify scaling opportunities without increasing risk exposure

You must understand advertising restrictions related to healthcare, medical claims, and regulated products.

2. Landing Page & Funnel Optimization (CRO)

  • Improve and test multiple funnels
  • Recommend landing page structure improvements
  • Suggest pricing tests, bundling experiments, and offer adjustments
  • Propose creative test variations to the Creative Director
  • Improve checkout and subscription flow performance

Important: You do not design visuals, but you drive performance testing strategy.

3. Compliance & Platform Policy Awareness

  • ​​Ensure campaigns comply with platform ad policies (Google, Meta, etc.)
  • Understand regulated marketing limitations (medical claims, disclaimers)
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to prevent account flags or shutdown risk
  • Maintain a risk-aware scaling strategy

4. Lifecycle & Retention (Critical Gap to Build)

Own and build our lifecycle marketing engine:

  • SMS automation
  • Email automation
  • Abandoned cart flows
  • Post-purchase sequences
  • Subscription retention campaigns
  • Win-back flows

Goals:

  • Increase LTV
  • Improve retention rates
  • Reduce churn
  • Personalize messaging based on behavior

Experience with Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms preferred.

5. Analytics & Attribution

  • Build reporting dashboards
  • Monitor CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, and LTV
  • Understand subscription economics (LTV > CAC model)
  • Improve attribution clarity across channels
  • Inform budget allocation decisions using data

What Success Looks Like

  • Scalable paid acquisition without compliance risk
  • Improved landing page conversion rates
  • Strong subscription retention engine
  • Predictable unit economics
  • Clear reporting and budget confidence

  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube)
    • Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram)
    • Reddit Ads
    • Tiktok Ads
    • Microsoft Ads (Bing)
    • App Lovin
    • Ad Roll
  • Experience in telehealth, healthcare, or regulated products preferred
  • Experience with subscription-based businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong CRO mindset
  • Experience building SMS + email lifecycle automations
  • Comfortable operating in a startup environment with ownership

This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who

  • Thinks in CAC vs LTV
  • Enjoys structured experimentation
  • Understands platform compliance nuance
  • Is analytical but commercially minded
  • Can operate without heavy hand-holding

Why Join LumiMeds

  • Real ownership of strategy and execution.
  • High visibility with leadership.
  • Opportunity to shape the marketing foundation of a Telehealth brand.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

# Paid Media Manager (Remote US) - Future Opening

## Location

Remote - United States; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Houston, TX; Minneapolis, MN; Phoenix, AZ; San Diego, CA

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

PerformancePaid Media

Directive Consulting is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: Performance, Communications, and Commerce, each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, DiscoverabilityOS™, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and Content Marketing, to PR and Paid Social, to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

The Paid Strategist is a crucial, client-facing role responsible for day-to-day client deliverables, creating and managing custom client strategies, and communicating with both clients and internal stakeholders on executing Paid Media deliverables. In this role, you will gain experience building high-performing Paid strategies for B2B businesses across Technology, Industrial, and Services markets.

_**\*This role is listed internally as Account Strategist, Paid Media**_ **\***

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

- Oversee and lead a collection of Paid Media accounts

- Serve as direct support to client contacts

- Weekly communication with any vendors or operational partners to ensure we're aligned on tasks being assigned, work quality, and any improvements we can make to that dynamic

- Drive referrals via client relationships and professional network

- Build strategies for clients each quarter

- Have the ability to create, maintain, and optimize budgets for paid media campaigns across multiple channels

- Deeply understand client positioning and unique value propositions

- Confirm lead routing is accurate within a CRM

- Understand the value of Programmatic campaigns

- Responsible for personal productivity and utilization

- Work directly with Associate Director to ensure internal and client goals are being achieved

- Execute and optimize PPC advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, focusing on keyword research, ad copywriting, and audience targeting to maximize ROI


**What You Offer:**

- 3+ years experience working at a performance/digital marketing agency

- Experience working specifically with B2B SaaS/tech clients in an agency setting

- Deep expertise across paid search and paid social advertising campaigns, such as Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads and others

- Proficiency in using advertising platforms and tools such as Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager

- Strong understanding of PPC principles, including keyword research, ad copywriting, bid management, and campaign optimization

- Ability to analyze campaign performance data using tools like Google Analytics, GA4, Excel, or other analytics platforms to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance

- Ability to drive results and measure via OCT

- Proven and measurable success with mid-market or enterprise accounts

- A unique perspective on how to drive value for SaaS

- Ability to translate and articulate strategy and tell stories with data

- Equal parts competitive and curious; you’re a true problem solver

- You live on the cutting edge of the industry, always looking for opportunities to grow and share

- Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously

- You’re quality-obsessed and have not lost your soul for advertising

- Driven to stay ahead of industry trends, including actively learning how AI and automation can enhance marketing and operations.

- **Travel to visit clients approximately once per year, per client or as needed**


**What Success Looks Like:**

- You encompass our core values through every interaction; internally and externally

- Effectively manage approximately five mid-tier and enterprise accounts

- Meet and exceed department level OKRs, such as client growth and goal attainment

- Build client trust and relationships that create consistent renewals

- Cross-sell services that align with client goals and objectives

- Clearly communicate results with client point of contact and executives

- Exceptional decision making, as it relates to strategic direction for accounts


**What We Offer:**

🏠 We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the United States is $70,000- $95,000 USD with potential for bonus eligibility. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.

🙏  Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents

Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

🧠  Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace

💪  Physical - Gympass

🛫 Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave

💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match

🌟  Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

[![Prenuvo logo](https://image.careerpuck.com/lp0qpwRL/lp0qpwRL.300.png)](https://prenuvo.com/)

# Performance Marketing Manager

Remote, USA

Apply

**About Us**

At [Prenuvo](http://prenuvo.com/), we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience of our clinics across North America, have allowed us to lead the charge against “we caught it too late again.”

Prenuvo is seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to support execution across our core acquisition channels. As the Performance Marketing Manager, you’ll be an embedded member of the Growth Marketing team—collaborating closely with internal leads to manage and optimize day-to-day campaigns for paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads).

Your primary focus will be tactical campaign management: implementing bid and budget optimizations, testing and refreshing ad copy and creative, cleaning up search terms, and executing cross-platform experiments that keep campaigns responsive to both performance data and evolving creative direction.

This role is a critical addition during a high-growth phase to sustain campaign momentum, drive efficiency, and scale Prenuvo’s customer acquisition through the busy season and beyond.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

**What You'll Do**

- Execute day-to-day campaign management + analysis across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit), paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) including bid, budget, audience, and creative optimizations.
- Refresh ad copy, creative assets, and extensions in collaboration with the internal team.
- Implement structured testing frameworks (copy, creative, audience, landing page) to identify performance drivers and scale winners.
- Analyze performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations that align with overall acquisition goals (CPA, ROAS, Cost/Purchase).
- Support the rollout of new channels and campaign types (YouTube, Demand Gen, etc.) as Prenuvo expands its media mix.
- Partner with internal teams on tracking and measurement to ensure high-quality signal input for campaign optimization.
- Collaborate with internal leads to deliver reports, insights, and recommendations for weekly reviews.
- Utilize paid media technology to manage campaigns, bids, and budgets at scale.

**What You'll Bring**

- 5-8 years of hands-on experience managing paid social and paid search campaigns.
- Proven success managing seven-figure monthly budgets and optimizing to CPA and ROAS targets.
- Deep proficiency in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), with a strong grasp of campaign structure, automation levers, and creative optimization.
- Strong analytical mindset; ability to interpret data and pivot quickly based on performance insights.
- Familiarity with other platforms such as Pinterest, Reddit and tools like Google Analytics a plus.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills; comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience in high-AOV consumer, healthcare, or wellness categories a plus.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

- Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

- We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are **Patients**

- We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

**What We Offer**

- An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
- We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
- Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
- Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
- Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
- Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
- We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
- **The base salary for this role ranges from $120,000-$150,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location**

_We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status._

_As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal and state rules._

**Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain \[** [**prenuvo.com**](http://prenuvo.com/) **\]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

Performance Marketing Manager","description":"<p><strong>About Us</strong></p>\n<p>At<a href=\"http://prenuvo.com/\"> Prenuvo</a>, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience of our clinics across North America, have allowed us to lead the charge against “we caught it too late again.” </p>\n<p>Prenuvo is seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to support execution across our core acquisition channels. As the Performance Marketing Manager, you’ll be an embedded member of the Growth Marketing team—collaborating closely with internal leads to manage and optimize day-to-day campaigns for paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads).</p>\n<p>Your primary focus will be tactical campaign management: implementing bid and budget optimizations, testing and refreshing ad copy and creative, cleaning up search terms, and executing cross-platform experiments that keep campaigns responsive to both performance data and evolving creative direction.</p>\n<p>This role is a critical addition during a high-growth phase to sustain campaign momentum, drive efficiency, and scale Prenuvo’s customer acquisition through the busy season and beyond.</p>\n<p><strong>This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).</strong></p>\n<p>Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!</p>\n<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Execute day-to-day campaign management + analysis across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit), paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) including bid, budget, audience, and creative optimizations.</li>\n<li>Refresh ad copy, creative assets, and extensions in collaboration with the internal team.</li>\n<li>Implement structured testing frameworks (copy, creative, audience, landing page) to identify performance drivers and scale winners.</li>\n<li>Analyze performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations that align with overall acquisition goals (CPA, ROAS, Cost/Purchase).</li>\n<li>Support the rollout of new channels and campaign types (YouTube, Demand Gen, etc.) as Prenuvo expands its media mix.</li>\n<li>Partner with internal teams on tracking and measurement to ensure high-quality signal input for campaign optimization.</li>\n<li>Collaborate with internal leads to deliver reports, insights, and recommendations for weekly reviews.</li>\n<li>Utilize paid media technology to manage campaigns, bids, and budgets at scale.</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>5-8 years of hands-on experience managing paid social and paid search campaigns.</li>\n<li>Proven success managing seven-figure monthly budgets and optimizing to CPA and ROAS targets.</li>\n<li>Deep proficiency in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), with a strong grasp of campaign structure, automation levers, and creative optimization.</li>\n<li>Strong analytical mindset; ability to interpret data and pivot quickly based on performance insights.</li>\n<li>Familiarity with other platforms such as Pinterest, Reddit and tools like Google Analytics a plus.</li>\n<li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills;     <div id="root"><div class="Toastify"></div><div class="Layout__Wrapper-sc-9lqxom-0 cagnKR"><div class="JobPagePublic__HeaderContainer-sc-6i2gji-0 jnNXKR"><div class="JobPagePublic__Header-sc-6i2gji-1 fAeMMj"><div class="JobPagePublic__LogoContainer-sc-6i2gji-21 cwEckT"><a href="https://prenuvo.com/"><img src="https://image.careerpuck.com/lp0qpwRL/lp0qpwRL.300.png" alt="Prenuvo logo" class="CompanyLogo__NonSvgImage-sc-zrwtpv-2 kxWCUm"></a></div><div data-testing="job-title-header" class="JobPagePublic__PageHeaderContainer-sc-6i2gji-2 laHVbr"><h1><div class="JobPagePublic__Role-sc-6i2gji-3 epxjhs role"> Performance Marketing Manager</div></h1><div class="JobPagePublic__HeaderSubtitleContainer-sc-6i2gji-4 kBBfxU"><div class="JobPagePublic__Location-sc-6i2gji-5 dunAVz">Remote, USA</div></div><button aria-label="Apply to  Performance Marketing Manager" class="PillButton__StyledButton-sc-13sfol-0 gbpOry">Apply</button></div></div></div><div class="JobPagePublic__ColumnsContainer-sc-6i2gji-20 eoXUka"><div class="JobPagePublic__MiddleColumn-sc-6i2gji-22 feGkTv"><div data-testing="job-description" class="JobPagePublic__About-sc-6i2gji-11 XRnMT job-description" color="#013333"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p>
<p>At<a href="http://prenuvo.com/"> Prenuvo</a>, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience of our clinics across North America, have allowed us to lead the charge against “we caught it too late again.” </p>
<p>Prenuvo is seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to support execution across our core acquisition channels. As the Performance Marketing Manager, you’ll be an embedded member of the Growth Marketing team—collaborating closely with internal leads to manage and optimize day-to-day campaigns for paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads).</p>
<p>Your primary focus will be tactical campaign management: implementing bid and budget optimizations, testing and refreshing ad copy and creative, cleaning up search terms, and executing cross-platform experiments that keep campaigns responsive to both performance data and evolving creative direction.</p>
<p>This role is a critical addition during a high-growth phase to sustain campaign momentum, drive efficiency, and scale Prenuvo’s customer acquisition through the busy season and beyond.</p>
<p><strong>This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).</strong></p>
<p>Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Execute day-to-day campaign management + analysis across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit), paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) including bid, budget, audience, and creative optimizations.</li>
<li>Refresh ad copy, creative assets, and extensions in collaboration with the internal team.</li>
<li>Implement structured testing frameworks (copy, creative, audience, landing page) to identify performance drivers and scale winners.</li>
<li>Analyze performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations that align with overall acquisition goals (CPA, ROAS, Cost/Purchase).</li>
<li>Support the rollout of new channels and campaign types (YouTube, Demand Gen, etc.) as Prenuvo expands its media mix.</li>
<li>Partner with internal teams on tracking and measurement to ensure high-quality signal input for campaign optimization.</li>
<li>Collaborate with internal leads to deliver reports, insights, and recommendations for weekly reviews.</li>
<li>Utilize paid media technology to manage campaigns, bids, and budgets at scale.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5-8 years of hands-on experience managing paid social and paid search campaigns.</li>
<li>Proven success managing seven-figure monthly budgets and optimizing to CPA and ROAS targets.</li>
<li>Deep proficiency in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), with a strong grasp of campaign structure, automation levers, and creative optimization.</li>
<li>Strong analytical mindset; ability to interpret data and pivot quickly based on performance insights.</li>
<li>Familiarity with other platforms such as Pinterest, Reddit and tools like Google Analytics a plus.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills; comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.</li>
<li>Experience in high-AOV consumer, healthcare, or wellness categories a plus.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Our Values <br></strong></p>
<p>First: we are <strong>Pioneers</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.</li>
</ul>
<p>Second: we are <strong>Platform-Builders</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.</li>
</ul>
<p>Above all: we are <strong>Patients</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health</li>
<li>We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member </li>
<li>Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way</li>
<li>Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize </li>
<li>Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it</li>
<li>Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.</li>
<li>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family</li>
<li><strong>The base salary for this role ranges from $120,000-$150,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><em>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</em></p>
<p><em>As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal and state rules.</em></p>

web.description:
# Demand Generation Program Manager | United States | Remote
**What Makes You a Great Fit**

- 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus).
- Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions.
- Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers.
- Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for.
- Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword.
- Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust.

**Bonus Points For**

- Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries.
- Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost.
- Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem.
- Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar).
- Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones.

- **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
- **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
- **In-Person onboarding**- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting.

You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. # Senior Performance Marketing Manager, HELOC Growth

### Senior Performance Marketing Manager, HELOC Growth

- R-7455


- Growth Department


**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team:**

Upstart’s Growth team is focused on expanding access to affordable credit for millions of Americans. The team combines marketing, data, and technology to scale customer acquisition in efficient and measurable ways. Direct Mail is a core channel within Growth and plays a critical role in reaching new borrowers and driving business performance.

As the **Senior Performance Marketing Manager,** **Direct Mail and Offline Growth**, you will own one of Upstart’s most impactful acquisition channels end-to-end, with a primary focus on our Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) product. This is one of the company’s fastest-growing and most strategically important offerings. You will define channel strategy, optimize targeting and creative, and lead execution to drive efficient, incremental growth. This role offers significant ownership, including P&L responsibility, and the opportunity to solve complex, high-impact problems in partnership with cross-functional teams.

**How you’ll make an impact**

- Own end-to-end Direct Mail strategy and execution for HELOC, including audience targeting, creative development, testing, and campaign operations
- Build our broader offline growth channels (OOH, linear TV, and brand testing)
- Manage and optimize millions in annual spend, with accountability for ROI and incremental business impact
- Partner with Machine Learning and Data Science teams to develop and refine targeting models that improve customer acquisition efficiency
- Design and execute rigorous testing frameworks (e.g., incrementality, geo-lift, A/B testing) to evaluate performance and inform strategy
- Analyze campaign and customer data to generate insights and translate findings into actionable growth opportunities
- Develop new playbooks to reach and convert underserved or underperforming customer segments, including emerging HELOC use cases
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Creative to scale channel performance and influence roadmap decisions
- Communicate strategy, performance, and insights to leadership, connecting channel outcomes to broader business goals

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
- 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or analytics-driven marketing roles
- Experience owning and executing end-to-end marketing campaigns, including strategy, testing, and performance analysis
- Experience managing marketing budgets and optimizing for measurable ROI or P&L outcomes
- Experience designing and analyzing controlled experiments (e.g., A/B testing, incrementality testing, or similar methodologies)

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with Direct Mail marketing strategy, execution, or channel ownership
- Experience working across multiple marketing channels (e.g., digital, offline, lifecycle)
- Knowledge of measurement frameworks such as incrementality testing, geo-lift, or attribution modeling
- Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare
- Skills in SQL, Looker, or similar tools to analyze and interpret large datasets

**Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote

**Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-MidSenior

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States \| Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range

$138,000—$192,000 USD

**What you'll love**

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

- Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
- Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
- Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
- Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
- Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
- Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
- Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
- Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
- Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
- Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
- Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
- Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
- Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

_If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com_

          <div id="job_description_e11264f34bdd3f8fcc366fdd239aa931" class="job-description"><div class="content-intro">
<p><strong>About Upstart</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.</p>
<p>As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.</p>
<p>We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.</p>
<p>If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
</div><p><strong>The Team: </strong></p>
<p>Upstart’s Growth team is focused on expanding access to affordable credit for millions of Americans. The team combines marketing, data, and technology to scale customer acquisition in efficient and measurable ways. Direct Mail is a core channel within Growth and plays a critical role in reaching new borrowers and driving business performance.</p>
<p>As the <strong>Senior Performance Marketing Manager, </strong><strong>Direct Mail and Offline Growth</strong>, you will own one of Upstart’s most impactful acquisition channels end-to-end, with a primary focus on our Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) product. This is one of the company’s fastest-growing and most strategically important offerings. You will define channel strategy, optimize targeting and creative, and lead execution to drive efficient, incremental growth. This role offers significant ownership, including P&L responsibility, and the opportunity to solve complex, high-impact problems in partnership with cross-functional teams.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own end-to-end Direct Mail strategy and execution for HELOC, including audience targeting, creative development, testing, and campaign operations</li>
<li>Build our broader offline growth channels (OOH, linear TV, and brand testing)</li>
<li>Manage and optimize millions in annual spend, with accountability for ROI and incremental business impact</li>
<li>Partner with Machine Learning and Data Science teams to develop and refine targeting models that improve customer acquisition efficiency</li>
<li>Design and execute rigorous testing frameworks (e.g., incrementality, geo-lift, A/B testing) to evaluate performance and inform strategy</li>
<li>Analyze campaign and customer data to generate insights and translate findings into actionable growth opportunities</li>
<li>Develop new playbooks to reach and convert underserved or underperforming customer segments, including emerging HELOC use cases</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Creative to scale channel performance and influence roadmap decisions</li>
<li>Communicate strategy, performance, and insights to leadership, connecting channel outcomes to broader business goals</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum Qualifications </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience</li>
<li>5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or analytics-driven marketing roles</li>
<li>Experience owning and executing end-to-end marketing campaigns, including strategy, testing, and performance analysis</li>
<li>Experience managing marketing budgets and optimizing for measurable ROI or P&L outcomes</li>
<li>Experience designing and analyzing controlled experiments (e.g., A/B testing, incrementality testing, or similar methodologies)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with Direct Mail marketing strategy, execution, or channel ownership</li>
<li>Experience working across multiple marketing channels (e.g., digital, offline, lifecycle)</li>
<li>Knowledge of measurement frameworks such as incrementality testing, geo-lift, or attribution modeling</li>
<li>Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare</li>
<li>Skills in SQL, Looker, or similar tools to analyze and interpret large datasets</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Position location</strong> This role is available in the following locations: Remote </p>
<p><strong>Time zone requirements</strong> The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.</p>
<p><strong>Travel requirements</strong> As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.</p>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>

<p>At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</p>
<p>In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).</p>

</div></div><div class="content-conclusion">
<p><strong>What you'll love</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly </li>
<li>Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)</li>
<li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)</li>
<li>Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.</li>
<li>Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)</li>
<li>Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security</li>
<li>Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements</li>
<li>Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)</li>
<li>Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs</li>
<li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources</li>
<li>Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)</li>
<li>Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you</li>
<li>Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from</li>
<li>Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City</li>
</ul>
<p>For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.</p>
<p>Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.</p>

Current openings at HCEsquared

About HCEsquared

HCEsquared, which stands for Health Care Experts Squared, is a management platform which drives enterprise support solutions across its portfolio of companies. We continue to find innovative ways to maximize the value of our portfolio through scaled systems and services, strategic leadership, and acquisition opportunities. We strive to grow our platform of companies providing services anchored in medical education for professionals to elevate patient care. 

For more details on our operating companies please visit:
Dermsquared - Dermatology education, insights, and publication platform - Dermsquared.com 
CMEsquared - Developer of accredited continuing medical education programs - CMEsquared.org

Diversity and Inclusion

HCEsquared is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We acknowledge that the clinicians and the patients they serve come from a variety of backgrounds that we can better serve by having a diverse workforce that can understand their viewpoints. Additionally, we believe that an inclusive environment that promotes diversity empowers our employees to thrive. We recognize that embracing diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, and socioeconomic background, enriches our organization and strengthens our ability to drive innovation and achieve excellence. This is an important value that we promote both with our internal and external stakeholders that we believe is key in building a successful organization.

 

Notice: Recruitment scams impersonating Dermsquared
We've become aware of fraudulent job offers and "interviews" being conducted by parties impersonating Dermsquared and its leadership. These scams use lookalike domains and email addresses that are not affiliated with us.
Please know that:
All legitimate communication from our recruiting team comes only from addresses ending in @dermsquared.com. We do not use any other domain (such as "recruitingdermsquared.com").
We never conduct interviews solely over text or chat, and we never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information before a formal, verified offer.
Open roles are posted on our official careers page and verified channels only.
If you've been contacted by someone claiming to represent Dermsquared and something feels off, please don't share any personal or financial information. Forward the message to [info@dermsquared.com] and we'll confirm whether it's genuine. If you believe you've been targeted, you can also report it to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center at ic3.gov.
We're grateful to the candidates who have flagged this and are actively working to shut these operations down.

- [![AirGarage](https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/org-theme-wordmark/c1f93f3f-c2e7-45fa-969f-af8e17cc6152/18390808-21c8-4518-9918-cd454bac2373/db5c5210-fb41-404d-bd48-5a555dd105b3.png)](https://www.airgarage.com/)
- [Back to AirGarage’s Job Listings](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/airgarage)

# Performance Marketing Manager

## Location

Remote; USA

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Marketing

## Compensation

- $125K – $160K • Offers Equity

**About AirGarage**

AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking.

We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities.

AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.

We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.

Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.

We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.

We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.

Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling?

Check out these podcasts:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4)

[https://youtu.be/\_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7](https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7)

# The Role 💼

You'll be AirGarage's first dedicated performance marketing hire, reporting to the Head of Marketing. You own paid media and campaign channels end to end: LinkedIn Ads, paid publications, Google Ads, and structured tests of emerging channels. Your job is to turn paid media into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline for a company selling to commercial real estate owners and leaders.

You're inheriting a nascent program where we’ve seen early signs of success, but the engine needs work. We know we're reaching the right accounts, but not enough of the right people are taking action. We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works.

This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on.

You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out.

## What You Will Do 📊

Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion.

Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient.

Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing.

Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show.

Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story.

Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month.

Produce your own creative with limited support from an in-house designer. Use templates and AI design tools to create static, video, and gif variations so testing velocity is never gated on design capacity.

## Who You Are 🦚

- You've run paid B2B ad programs with pipeline accountability. You can walk us through a channel you scaled, the tests that got it there, and the ones that failed.

- LinkedIn Campaigns Manager is your second home. You understand how to target with precision, how to run effective tests, and understand how to solve for its attribution quirks.

- You're rigorous about testing. You form a hypothesis, isolate a variable, set the success criteria before launch, and kill things that don't work without getting attached.

- You're fluent in the full funnel. You care about what happens after the click as much as the click itself, and you can diagnose whether a problem is the audience, the creative, the offer, or the landing page.

- You're scrappy. This is a build-it-yourself role at a startup. You can use templates and tools to design your own ads, write your own copy, and build your own [campaigns.You](http://campaigns.you/)'d rather test five rough variations this week than wait two weeks for one polished one.

- You're comfortable in the data, can pull metrics yourself, report out on them, and explain the difference between influence and causation.

- You use AI tools and want to build workflows with them, not resist them. You think about AI as leverage on your judgment, not a replacement for it.

- You're commercially minded. You measure yourself on qualified pipeline and revenue, not impressions.


## ⭐️ Nice To Have:

- Experience marketing to commercial real estate, proptech, or another long-cycle B2B category with a small, high-value buyer universe.

- Experience managing paid newsletter and publication partnerships.

- Experience running ABM air cover and retargeting programs tied to a sales team's target accounts.

- Early experience with ChatGPT ads or other emerging channels


## 🚨 Why This Role May Not Be for You 🚨

Please review this section before applying. We are sharing this information up front because we don't expect this job to be appealing to everybody and we do not want to waste your time if you are not on board with all of the following. Below are some of the reasons you might not want this job:

- You want a strict 9-5. We work long hours at AirGarage, including nights and occasional weekends, because we love what we do.

- You don't operate quickly. We work at a fast pace and value iteration and experimentation.

- You need a fully built playbook. This is the first performance marketing hire, so you'll be building the testing framework, the reporting, and the channel processes, not inheriting them.

- You want to set it and forget it. The channels that work here are the ones that get tested and refined every week. Managing spend without changing anything is not the job.

- You're uncomfortable with imperfect data. Our attribution is still maturing, and part of your job is improving it while making decisions with what we have.

- You only want to run ads. This role includes managing publication partnerships, coordinating with outbound and ABM, and building reporting. A lot of the job is cross-functional.

- You need a large cross-functional team. Marketing at AirGarage is lean, and you'll be the only person dedicated to paid media.

- You need a dedicated designer. There is no full-time brand designer on this team.
