This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on.

You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out.


WHAT YOU WILL DO 📊

Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion.

Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient.

Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing.

Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show.

Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story.

Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month.

Produce your own creative with limited support from an in-house designer. Use templates and AI design tools to create static, video, and gif variations so testing velocity is never gated on design capacity.


WHO YOU ARE 🦚

 - You've run paid B2B ad programs with pipeline accountability. You can walk us through a channel you scaled, the tests that got it there, and the ones that failed.

 - LinkedIn Campaigns Manager is your second home. You understand how to target with precision, how to run effective tests, and understand how to solve for its attribution quirks.

 - You're rigorous about testing. You form a hypothesis, isolate a variable, set the success criteria before launch, and kill things that don't work without getting attached.

 - You're fluent in the full funnel. You care about what happens after the click as much as the click itself, and you can diagnose whether a problem is the audience, the creative, the offer, or the landing page.

 - You're scrappy. This is a build-it-yourself role at a startup. You can use templates and tools to design your own ads, write your own copy, and build your own campaigns.You http://campaigns.You'd rather test five rough variations this week than wait two weeks for one polished one.

 - You're comfortable in the data, can pull metrics yourself, report out on them, and explain the difference between influence and causation.

 - You use AI tools and want to build workflows with them, not resist them. You think about AI as leverage on your judgment, not a replacement for it.

 - You're commercially minded. You measure yourself on qualified pipeline and revenue, not impressions.


⭐️ NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience marketing to commercial real estate, proptech, or another long-cycle B2B category with a small, high-value buyer universe.

 - Experience managing paid newsletter and publication partnerships.

 - Experience running ABM air cover and retargeting programs tied to a sales team's target accounts.

 - Early experience with ChatGPT ads or other emerging channels


🚨 WHY THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE FOR YOU 🚨

 - You don't operate quickly. We work at a fast pace and value iteration and experimentation.

 - You need a fully built playbook. This is the first performance marketing hire, so you'll be building the testing framework, the reporting, and the channel processes, not inheriting them.

 - You only want to run ads. This role includes managing publication partnerships, coordinating with outbound and ABM, and building reporting. A lot of the job is cross-functional.

 - You need a large cross-functional team. Marketing at AirGarage is lean, and you'll be the only person dedicated to paid media.

 - You need a dedicated designer. There is no full-time brand designer on this team. If you can't ship a new ad without a design ticket, you'll be stuck.

 - 2–3 full company offsites, “Remote Weeks”

 - Lending a hand to support one new location launch

 - In-person onboarding as well as supporting other onboarding sessions for new team members

We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.<br><br>Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling? <br><br>Check out these podcasts: <br><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4</a><br><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7">https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7</a></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><h1>The Role 💼</h1><p style="min-height:1.5em">You'll be AirGarage's first dedicated performance marketing hire, reporting to the Head of Marketing. You own paid media and campaign channels end to end: LinkedIn Ads, paid publications, Google Ads, and structured tests of emerging channels. Your job is to turn paid media into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline for a company selling to commercial real estate owners and leaders.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're inheriting a nascent program where we’ve seen early signs of success, but the engine needs work. We know we're reaching the right accounts, but not enough of the right people are taking action. We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><h2>What You Will Do 📊</h2><p style="min-height:1.5em">Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Produce your own creative with limited support from an in-house designer. Use templates and AI design tools to create static, video, and gif variations so testing velocity is never gated on design capacity.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><h2>Who You Are 🦚</h2><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You've run paid B2B ad programs with pipeline accountability. You can walk us through a channel you scaled, the tests that got it there, and the ones that failed.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">LinkedIn Campaigns Manager is your second home. You understand how to target with precision, how to run effective tests, and understand how to solve for its attribution quirks.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're rigorous about testing. You form a hypothesis, isolate a variable, set the success criteria before launch, and kill things that don't work without getting attached.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're fluent in the full funnel. You care about what happens after the click as much as the click itself, and you can diagnose whether a problem is the audience, the creative, the offer, or the landing page.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're scrappy. This is a build-it-yourself role at a startup. You can use templates and tools to design your own ads, write your own copy, and build your own <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="http://campaigns.you/">campaigns.You</a>'d rather test five rough variations this week than wait two weeks for one polished one.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're comfortable in the data, can pull metrics yourself, report out on them, and explain the difference between influence and causation.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You use AI tools and want to build workflows with them, not resist them. You think about AI as leverage on your judgment, not a replacement for it.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're commercially minded. You measure yourself on qualified pipeline and revenue, not impressions.</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><h2>⭐️ Nice To Have:</h2><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Experience marketing to commercial real estate, proptech, or another long-cycle B2B category with a small, high-value buyer universe.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Experience managing paid newsletter and publication partnerships.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Experience running ABM air cover and retargeting programs tied to a sales team's target accounts.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Early experience with ChatGPT ads or other emerging channels</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><h2>🚨 Why This Role May Not Be for You 🚨 </h2><p style="min-height:1.5em">Please review this section before applying. We are sharing this information up front because we don't expect this job to be appealing to everybody and we do not want to waste your time if you are not on board with all of the following. Below are some of the reasons you might not want this job:</p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You want a strict 9-5. We work long hours at AirGarage, including nights and occasional weekends, because we love what we do.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You don't operate quickly. We work at a fast pace and value iteration and experimentation.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You need a fully built playbook. This is the first performance marketing hire, so you'll be building the testing framework, the reporting, and the channel processes, not inheriting them.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You want to set it and forget it. The channels that work here are the ones that get tested and refined every week. Managing spend without changing anything is not the job.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You're uncomfortable with imperfect data. Our attribution is still maturing, and part of your job is improving it while making decisions with what we have.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You only want to run ads. This role includes managing publication partnerships, coordinating with outbound and ABM, and building reporting. A lot of the job is cross-functional.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You need a large cross-functional team. Marketing at AirGarage is lean, and you'll be the only person dedicated to paid media.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">You need a dedicated designer. There is no full-time brand designer on this team. You'll build your own ad creative using Claude Design, templates you work with our in-house designer on, and AI tools for testing video and gif variations. If you can't ship a new ad without a design ticket, you'll be stuck.</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>IMPORTANT NOTE 🚨</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">AirGarage is a remote-first company, but we also value in-person collaboration to strengthen trust and teamwork. Team members should expect ~6 weeks of travel per year for:</p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">2–3 full company offsites, “Remote Weeks”</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Lending a hand to support one new location launch</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">In-person onboarding as well as supporting other onboarding sessions for new team members</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em">The rest of the year, team members can work remotely from wherever (US time zones) they’re most comfortable as long as they are performing well in their role. Attendance at in-person events throughout the year is expected—if you’re not open to traveling ~6 weeks per year for work, our team won't be a good fit for you.</p><div style="min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"> </div><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>THE UPSIDE 📈</strong></p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">📈 Equity: Have a stake in the business that you’re helping to build and grow.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">🌴 Work remotely: Live and work wherever you like! We believe in folks working where they are happiest and most productive. We currently hire teammates that are located anywhere within North America.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">🏥 Health insurance: We offer health insurance and currently cover 85% of the cost of medical, dental, and vision plans for the primary employee and 50% of the cost of plans for dependents.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">🍼 Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. The 12 weeks can be taken as a continuous leave or intermittently over the first 18 months of the child's life. </p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">💻 Home office setup: Get a laptop + additional equipment needed to set you up for success.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">⛺ Time to recharge: We have an unlimited PTO policy with a minimum requirement of 10 days per year.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">🤑 401k: Make financial planning right for you with a 401k retirement savings program.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">✈️ Team Off-sites: ~2 times per year our team comes together for a full week in places like Tahoe, Charleston, San Diego, Park City, and Austin.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">📚 BookGarage: Our team loves to learn and grow together, so join us for our optional recurring book club.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">🪴Room to grow:  Our team will be orders of magnitude larger within a few years; as a part of our foundational team, you'll have opportunities to grow with us.  </p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">🏙️ Transform our cities: The opportunity to change the way that the world thinks about real estate use in our cities.</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">👐 Work with a diverse team: At AirGarage, we've always been committed to building a thriving team that represents the communities we serve. Our team is currently 40% female and 30%+ from underrepresented communities.</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>Note</strong>: Employment with AirGarage is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and employment verification conducted in compliance with applicable laws. Background checks are completed only after a conditional offer of employment has been made.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><em>We understand that there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for someone passionate, with grit and determination, who is excited to face the challenges of a rapidly growing startup. About AirGarage 

AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking.

We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities.

AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.

We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.

Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.

We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.

We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.

Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling? 

Check out these podcasts: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4
https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7


THE ROLE 💼

You'll be AirGarage's first dedicated performance marketing hire, reporting to the Head of Marketing. You own paid media and campaign channels end to end: LinkedIn Ads, paid publications, Google Ads, and structured tests of emerging channels. Your job is to turn paid media into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline for a company selling to commercial real estate owners and leaders.

You're inheriting a nascent program where we’ve seen early signs of success, but the engine needs work. We know we're reaching the right accounts, but not enough of the right people are taking action. We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works.

This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on.

You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out.


WHAT YOU WILL DO 📊

Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion.

Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient.

Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing.

Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show.

Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story.

Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month.

We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.

We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.

Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.

We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.

We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.

We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works.

This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on.

You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out.


WHAT YOU WILL DO 📊

Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion.

Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient.

Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing.

Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show.

Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story.

Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month.

Produce your own creative with limited support from an in-house designer. Use templates and AI design tools to create static, video, and gif variations so testing velocity is never gated on design capacity.


WHO YOU ARE 🦚

 - You've run paid B2B ad programs with pipeline accountability. You can walk us through a channel you scaled, the tests that got it there, and the ones that failed.

 - LinkedIn Campaigns Manager is your second home. You understand how to target with precision, how to run effective tests, and understand how to solve for its attribution quirks.

 - You're rigorous about testing. You form a hypothesis, isolate a variable, set the success criteria before launch, and kill things that don't work without getting attached.

 - You're fluent in the full funnel. You care about what happens after the click as much as the click itself, and you can diagnose whether a problem is the audience, the creative, the offer, or the landing page.

 - You're scrappy. This is a build-it-yourself role at a startup. You can use templates and tools to design your own ads, write your own copy, and build your own campaigns.You http://campaigns.You'd rather test five rough variations this week than wait two weeks for one polished one.

 - You're comfortable in the data, can pull metrics yourself, report out on them, and explain the difference between influence and causation.

 - You use AI tools and want to build workflows with them, not resist them. You think about AI as leverage on your judgment, not a replacement for it.

 - You're commercially minded. You measure yourself on qualified pipeline and revenue, not impressions.


⭐️ NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience marketing to commercial real estate, proptech, or another long-cycle B2B category with a small, high-value buyer universe.

 - Experience managing paid newsletter and publication partnerships.

 - Experience running ABM air cover and retargeting programs tied to a sales team's target accounts.

 - Early experience with ChatGPT ads or other emerging channels


🚨 WHY THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE FOR YOU 🚨 

Please review this section before applying. We are sharing this information up front because we don't expect this job to be appealing to everybody and we do not want to waste your time if you are not on board with all of the following. Below are some of the reasons you might not want this job:

 - You want a strict 9-5. We work long hours at AirGarage, including nights and occasional weekends, because we love what we do.

 - You don't operate quickly. We work at a fast pace and value iteration and experimentation.

 - You need a fully built playbook. This is the first performance marketing hire, so you'll be building the testing framework, the reporting, and the channel processes, not inheriting them.

 - You want to set it and forget it. The channels that work here are the ones that get tested and refined every week. Managing spend without changing anything is not the job.

 - You're uncomfortable with imperfect data. Our attribution is still maturing, and part of your job is improving it while making decisions with what we have.

 - You only want to run ads. This role includes managing publication partnerships, coordinating with outbound and ABM, and building reporting. A lot of the job is cross-functional.

 - You need a large cross-functional team. Marketing at AirGarage is lean, and you'll be the only person dedicated to paid media.

 - You need a dedicated designer. There is no full-time brand designer on this team. You'll build your own ad creative using Claude Design, templates you work with our in-house designer on, and AI tools for testing video and gif variations. If you can't ship a new ad without a design ticket, you'll be stuck.

IMPORTANT NOTE 🚨

AirGarage is a remote-first company, but we also value in-person collaboration to strengthen trust and teamwork. Team members should expect ~6 weeks of travel per year for:

 - 2–3 full company offsites, “Remote Weeks”

 - Lending a hand to support one new location launch

 - In-person onboarding as well as supporting other onboarding sessions for new team members

The rest of the year, team members can work remotely from wherever (US time zones) they’re most comfortable as long as they are performing well in their role. Attendance at in-person events throughout the year is expected—if you’re not open to traveling ~6 weeks per year for work, our team won't be a good fit for you.

 

THE UPSIDE 📈

 - 📈 Equity: Have a stake in the business that you’re helping to build and grow.

 - 🌴 Work remotely: Live and work wherever you like! We believe in folks working where they are happiest and most productive. We currently hire teammates that are located anywhere within North America.

 - 🏥 Health insurance: We offer health insurance and currently cover 85% of the cost of medical, dental, and vision plans for the primary employee and 50% of the cost of plans for dependents.

 - 🍼 Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. The 12 weeks can be taken as a continuous leave or intermittently over the first 18 months of the child's life. 

 - 💻 Home office setup: Get a laptop + additional equipment needed to set you up for success.

 - ⛺ Time to recharge: We have an unlimited PTO policy with a minimum requirement of 10 days per year.

 - 🤑 401k: Make financial planning right for you with a 401k retirement savings program.

 - ✈️ Team Off-sites: ~2 times per year our team comes together for a full week in places like Tahoe, Charleston, San Diego, Park City, and Austin.

 - 📚 BookGarage: Our team loves to learn and grow together, so join us for our optional recurring book club.

 - 🪴Room to grow:  Our team will be orders of magnitude larger within a few years; as a part of our foundational team, you'll have opportunities to grow with us.  

 - 🏙️ Transform our cities: The opportunity to change the way that the world thinks about real estate use in our cities.

 - 👐 Work with a diverse team: At AirGarage, we've always been committed to building a thriving team that represents the communities we serve. Our team is currently 40% female and 30%+ from underrepresented communities.

Note: Employment with AirGarage is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and employment verification conducted in compliance with applicable laws. Background checks are completed only after a conditional offer of employment has been made.

We understand that there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for someone passionate, with grit and determination, who is excited to face the challenges of a rapidly growing startup. AirGarage is the type of company where you can grow exponentially, and we encourage you to apply to us even if you don't 100% match the candidate description.

AirGarage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance.  We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

# Sr. Marketing Manager (Demand Generation)

Remote

Apply

## Company Description

At PayNearMe, we’re on a mission to make paying and getting paid as simple as possible. We build innovative technology that transforms the way businesses and their customers experience payments. Our industry-leading platform, PayXM™, is the first of its kind—designed to manage the entire payment experience from start to finish. Every click, swipe or tap is seamless, fast and secure, helping non-commerce businesses boost customer satisfaction, accelerate payments, and reduce costs.

Our single platform handles it all: cards, ACH, digital wallets such as PayPal, Venmo, Cash App Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and even cash at more than 62,000 retail locations nationwide. Today, thousands of businesses across consumer lending, iGaming and online sports betting, property management, and tolling trust PayNearMe to deliver a payment experience that drives real results.

In September 2025, we raised a $50 million Series E funding round to accelerate our growth.

We’re a team of 300+ employees across 41 states, headquartered in Silicon Valley with satellite offices in Dallas, TX and Holmdel, NJ.

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of payments—one experience at a time.

PayNearMe is looking for a results-driven Senior Marketing Manager, Demand Gen to own demand initiatives and campaign execution for our Financial Institutions and Lending vertical.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role with significant ownership and visibility. Working from a focused universe of accounts, you will build integrated, account-based programs that engage the right buyers, generate sales meetings, and create qualified opportunities. Your success will be measured primarily by target-account engagement, sales meetings set, and opportunities created—outcomes shared with Sales to keep our revenue teams aligned.

You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Event Marketing. You will also direct outside partners supporting paid media, publisher programs, design, and asset production.

This role is well suited to someone who can set a clear strategy, turn it into an organized campaign plan, execute the details, and take ownership of results from the first brief through final performance analysis.

**Responsibilities:**

- Adapt and deliver the demand generation strategy for the Financial Institutions and Lending market, translating revenue priorities into campaign themes, channel plans, and measurable goals
- Plan and execute integrated campaigns across advertising, industry events, direct mail, digital experiences, webinars and other targeted channels
- Own campaigns from end to end, including the campaign brief, audience and account selection, offer, channel mix, asset requirements, launch plan, sales follow-up, measurement, optimization, and post-campaign recommendations
- Establish a strong operating rhythm with Sales around target accounts, campaign participation, meeting goals, follow-up responsibilities, account feedback, and opportunity outcomes
- Work with Product Marketing and Content Marketing to turn market insights, buyer needs, and product messaging into compelling campaign concepts, content, offers, and sales-ready programs
- Report on the effectiveness of campaigns with a mix of data analysis and storytelling to cut through the noise and implement concrete recommendations for improvement
- Manage campaign budgets thoughtfully, evaluate channel and vendor performance, and recommend how investments should be allocated to produce the greatest revenue impact
- Maintain an organized, visible campaign calendar and project plan to ensure visibility across marketing, sales and other departments

**Qualifications:**

- 8-10 years of B2B demand generation, account-based marketing, field marketing, or integrated campaign experience, preferably supporting enterprise SaaS, fintech, payments, or another complex technology solution
- A strong background in campaign development and program execution
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage a layered demand function
- Experience turning industry events into measurable demand programs
- Experience managing agencies, contractors, publishers, or other external partners and holding them accountable for quality, timelines, and performance
- A strong ownership mindset - you care about getting results less than sticking to rigid ways of doing things
- Strong strategic thinking and creative approach to problem solving
- Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills
- Occasional need to travel to select industry events and company or team meetings
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

_The annual base salary range for this role represents PayNearMe's good-faith estimate of the base salary it reasonably expects to offer for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including the candidate's experience,_ _qualifications, skills, and work location. PayNearMe may offer compensation outside of this range in certain circumstances. This position will remain posted until filled._

Annual Salary Range

$135,000 \- $170,000USD

**Why Join Us?:**

- Competitive salary and benefits with growth-company options grant
- Fast- paced and professional work culture
- Stock options with standard startup vesting - 1 year cliff; 4 years total
- $50 monthly communication expense stipend to go towards your phone/internet bill
- $250 stipend to enhance your WFH setup
- Reimbursement for peripheral equipment: monitor (up to $400), keyboard and mouse (up to $200)
- Premium medical benefits including vision and dental (100% coverage for employees)
- Company-sponsored life and disability insurance
- Paid parental bonding leave
- Paid sick leave, jury duty, bereavement
- 401k plan
- Flexible Time Off (our team members typically take off ~3-4 weeks per year)
- Volunteer Time Off
- 13 scheduled holidays


PayNearMe strives to create a workplace where all employees thrive. Our [core values](https://home.paynearme.com/about/careers/) represent who we are today and we take pride in the way we work with each other as well as with our stakeholders.

We’re in this **together** to **do the right thing**. We deliver **real results** we are proud of while remaining **respectful**, **transparent**, and **flexible**.

_PayNearMe is an equal opportunity employer. We are diligently and thoughtfully working towards cultivating a diverse workforce which in turn, enhances our products and services for the communities we serve. Applicants who represent all backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply._

Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our job applicant privacy notice found at: [https://home.paynearme.com/ccpa-privacy-notice-jobs-employees/](https://home.paynearme.com/ccpa-privacy-notice-jobs-employees/)

Today, thousands of businesses across consumer lending, iGaming and online sports betting, property management, and tolling trust PayNearMe to deliver a payment experience that drives real results.

In September 2025, we raised a $50 million Series E funding round to accelerate our growth. 

We’re a team of 300+ employees across 41 states, headquartered in Silicon Valley with satellite offices in Dallas, TX and Holmdel, NJ.

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of payments—one experience at a time.

 

PayNearMe is looking for a results-driven Senior Marketing Manager, Demand Gen to own demand initiatives and campaign execution for our Financial Institutions and Lending vertical.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role with significant ownership and visibility. Working from a focused universe of accounts, you will build integrated, account-based programs that engage the right buyers, generate sales meetings, and create qualified opportunities. Your success will be measured primarily by target-account engagement, sales meetings set, and opportunities created—outcomes shared with Sales to keep our revenue teams aligned.

You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Event Marketing. You will also direct outside partners supporting paid media, publisher programs, design, and asset production.


This role is well suited to someone who can set a clear strategy, turn it into an organized campaign plan, execute the details, and take ownership of results from the first brief through final performance analysis.  

Responsibilities:

  • Adapt and deliver the demand generation strategy for the Financial Institutions and Lending market, translating revenue priorities into campaign themes, channel plans, and measurable goals
  • Plan and execute integrated campaigns across advertising, industry events, direct mail, digital experiences, webinars and other targeted channels
  • Own campaigns from end to end, including the campaign brief, audience and account selection, offer, channel mix, asset requirements, launch plan, sales follow-up, measurement, optimization, and post-campaign recommendations
  • Establish a strong operating rhythm with Sales around target accounts, campaign participation, meeting goals, follow-up responsibilities, account feedback, and opportunity outcomes
  • Work with Product Marketing and Content Marketing to turn market insights, buyer needs, and product messaging into compelling campaign concepts, content, offers, and sales-ready programs
  • Report on the effectiveness of campaigns with a mix of data analysis and storytelling to cut through the noise and implement concrete recommendations for improvement
  • Manage campaign budgets thoughtfully, evaluate channel and vendor performance, and recommend how investments should be allocated to produce the greatest revenue impact
  • Maintain an organized, visible campaign calendar and project plan to ensure visibility across marketing, sales and other departments

Qualifications:

  • 8-10 years of B2B demand generation, account-based marketing, field marketing, or integrated campaign experience, preferably supporting enterprise SaaS, fintech, payments, or another complex technology solution
  • A strong background in campaign development and program execution
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage a layered demand function
  • Experience turning industry events into measurable demand programs
  • Experience managing agencies, contractors, publishers, or other external partners and holding them accountable for quality, timelines, and performance
  • A strong ownership mindset - you care about getting results less than sticking to rigid ways of doing things 
  • Strong strategic thinking and creative approach to problem solving
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills
  • Occasional need to travel to select industry events and company or team meetings
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

 

The annual base salary range for this role represents PayNearMe's good-faith estimate of the base salary it reasonably expects to offer for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and work location. PayNearMe may offer compensation outside of this range in certain circumstances. This position will remain posted until filled.

Annual Salary Range

$135,000 - $170,000 USD

 

Why Join Us?:

  • Competitive salary and benefits with growth-company options grant
  • Fast- paced and professional work culture
  • Stock options with standard startup vesting - 1 year cliff; 4 years total
  • $50 monthly communication expense stipend to go towards your phone/internet bill
  • $250 stipend to enhance your WFH setup
  • Reimbursement for peripheral equipment: monitor (up to $400), keyboard and mouse (up to $200)
  • Premium medical benefits including vision and dental (100% coverage for employees)
  • Company-sponsored life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental bonding leave
  • Paid sick leave, jury duty, bereavement
  • 401k plan
  • Flexible Time Off (our team members typically take off ~3-4 weeks per year)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • 13 scheduled holidays

 

PayNearMe strives to create a workplace where all employees thrive. Our core values represent who we are today and we take pride in the way we work with each other as well as with our stakeholders.

We’re in this together to do the right thing. We deliver real results we are proud of while remaining respectful, transparent, and flexible.

PayNearMe is an equal opportunity employer. We are diligently and thoughtfully working towards cultivating a diverse workforce which in turn, enhances our products and services for the communities we serve. Applicants who represent all backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our job applicant privacy notice found at: https://home.paynearme.com/ccpa-privacy-notice-jobs-employees/

# Performance Marketing Manager
## Location
United States Remote

## Employment Type
Full time

## Location Type
Remote

## Department
Product

## Compensation
### YOUR MISSION
You will own Mural's paid marketing end to end: the channels, the budget, and the results. Paid plays a role across the full funnel and supports the different ways Mural grows, from building early awareness to reaching people when they are ready to act.

### WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own strategy, budget, execution, and reporting for paid across search, paid social, and video and display, running it as one connected program across the full funnel.
- You will own Mural’s paid marketing end to end, with a focus on generating efficient growth across self-serve acquisition and sales-assisted demand. Success will be measured by the quality and volume of activated users, qualified pipeline, and revenue generated from paid investment.
- Build and run a continuous experimentation program across audiences, creative, landing pages, and offers.
- Lead agency and vendor partners to execute and scale the program.
- Partner with our Data team on attribution and measurement to connect paid spend to real outcomes.
- Set performance targets and expand the program into new regions and languages, including EMEA and APAC.
- Support account-based and demand generation programs in close partnership with the Sales and RevOps teams.
- Use AI in your daily workflow to move faster across keyword, creative, analysis, and reporting work, with a point of view on where AI is changing paid marketing.

### WHAT YOU'LL BRING
- 5+ years of hands-on B2B digital and performance marketing, owning paid search, paid social, and video or display with real budget responsibility.
- A full funnel operator comfortable across both self-serve growth and sales-assisted demand. You have owned awareness and demand creation, not only bottom funnel capture, and can show how top of funnel and account-based work pay off downstream.

# Performance Marketing Manager

## Location

United States Remote

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Product

## Compensation

- USA Compensation RangeEstimated Base Salary $131,840 – $164,800

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

### ABOUT THE TEAM

At Mural, we're changing how teams collaborate, think, and make decisions together. Growth Marketing sits inside Product and owns how people discover Mural and decide to start. Paid is a core acquisition engine for the business, working across both our self-serve and sales-assisted motions. You will own it end to end and work closely with partners across Product, Marketing, and Sales to turn demand into teams that rely on Mural.

### YOUR MISSION

You will own Mural's paid marketing end to end: the channels, the budget, and the results. Paid plays a role across the full funnel and supports the different ways Mural grows, from building early awareness to reaching people when they are ready to act. You will bring these efforts together into one connected program, lean on experimentation and measurement to learn what works, and help turn marketing investment into durable growth.

### WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own strategy, budget, execution, and reporting for paid across search, paid social, and video and display, running it as one connected program across the full funnel.

- You will own Mural’s paid marketing end to end, with a focus on generating efficient growth across self-serve acquisition and sales-assisted demand. Success will be measured by the quality and volume of activated users, qualified pipeline, and revenue generated from paid investment.

- Build and run a continuous experimentation program across audiences, creative, landing pages, and offers.

- Lead agency and vendor partners to execute and scale the program.

- Partner with our Data team on attribution and measurement to connect paid spend to real outcomes.

- Partner across Marketing and Web on messaging and the post-click experience.

- Set performance targets and expand the program into new regions and languages, including EMEA and APAC.

- Support account-based and demand generation programs in close partnership with the Sales and RevOps teams.

- Use AI in your daily workflow to move faster across keyword, creative, analysis, and reporting work, with a point of view on where AI is changing paid marketing.


### WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years of hands-on B2B digital and performance marketing, owning paid search, paid social, and video or display with real budget responsibility.

- A full funnel operator comfortable across both self-serve growth and sales-assisted demand. You have owned awareness and demand creation, not only bottom funnel capture, and can show how top of funnel and account-based work pay off downstream.

- You design and read clean tests across audiences, creative, and landing pages, and you know what to do with an inconclusive result.

- Comfort living in the performance data, with hands-on fluency in SQL, product analytics, and BI tools.

- A real point of view on measurement. You know where last-click falls short and have used holdouts, incrementally, or media mix testing to judge channels that do not attribute cleanly.

- Experience running paid inside a self-serve or freemium model, with a feel for how acquisition connects to activation and retention.

- A self-starter who is motivated and scrappy, thinks through problems, and brings innovative solutions in a high-growth environment.


### Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Compensation Range: $131,840 - $164,800

[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mural/c5c3f1cb-eaea-4bc5-ba85-82829040edf0/application)

Paid plays a role across the full funnel and supports the different ways Mural grows, from building early awareness to reaching people when they are ready to act. You will bring these efforts together into one connected program, lean on experimentation and measurement to learn what works, and help turn marketing investment into durable growth.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own strategy, budget, execution, and reporting for paid across search, paid social, and video and display, running it as one connected program across the full funnel.

 - You will own Mural’s paid marketing end to end, with a focus on generating efficient growth across self-serve acquisition and sales-assisted demand. Success will be measured by the quality and volume of activated users, qualified pipeline, and revenue generated from paid investment.

 - Build and run a continuous experimentation program across audiences, creative, landing pages, and offers.

 - Lead agency and vendor partners to execute and scale the program.

 - Partner with our Data team on attribution and measurement to connect paid spend to real outcomes.

 - Partner across Marketing and Web on messaging and the post-click experience.

 - Set performance targets and expand the program into new regions and languages, including EMEA and APAC.

 - Support account-based and demand generation programs in close partnership with the Sales and RevOps teams.

 - Use AI in your daily workflow to move faster across keyword, creative, analysis, and reporting work, with a point of view on where AI is changing paid marketing. 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of hands-on B2B digital and performance marketing, owning paid search, paid social, and video or display with real budget responsibility.

 - A full funnel operator comfortable across both self-serve growth and sales-assisted demand. You have owned awareness and demand creation, not only bottom funnel capture, and can show how top of funnel and account-based work pay off downstream.

 - You design and read clean tests across audiences, creative, and landing pages, and you know what to do with an inconclusive result.

 - Comfort living in the performance data, with hands-on fluency in SQL, product analytics, and BI tools.

 - A real point of view on measurement. You know where last-click falls short and have used holdouts, incrementally, or media mix testing to judge channels that do not attribute cleanly.

 - Experience running paid inside a self-serve or freemium model, with a feel for how acquisition connects to activation and retention.

 - A self-starter who is motivated and scrappy, thinks through problems, and brings innovative solutions in a high-growth environment. 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

tools.description: Start here for job discovery and employer comparison by hiring activity. Resolve a city/state with suggest_locations first when you need a location; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the following page. Sponsored cards are mixed in and page composition varies between fetches.

Start here to find job detail URLs and company slugs; pass page=next_page to continue. Filter by posting date (posted_within_days) and annual pay floor (min_annual_pay); title and city/state select the page. Distance, employment-type and location-type filters are not exposed.
After search_jobs, with the company slug from a card's company_url (e.g. YO-AI-Labs from /co/YO-AI-Labs/Jobs) and a city.
Start here with a board slug to enumerate openings. Pass next_page back as page. Use job for the description, compensation philosophy and deadline of one posting.
After search_jobs or company_jobs, with a card's url. Any pasted ziprecruiter.com /c/.../Job/... URL with a jid works.
Discovery: find Wayfair jobs by title words or filters and get their job_id for get_job. Keywords match the job title only (not the description). Use list_filters for the id vocabularies.
Pay benchmark for a title and city; not a posting's pay (that is on the job card).

Start here with an employer slug (or company_id from company) to enumerate its openings; pass next_page back as page. Use category_ids from categories or this function's aggregations, city_id from company offices or aggregations. There is no keyword search on JOIN.
When you have a job id or last_id from jobs, or a pasted ad URL (join.com/companies/<slug>/<id_param> or join.com/jobs/<last_id>), and need the description, salary, hours, vacation or contract terms.

Use when all you have is a company's website: resolves it to one advertiser and returns the same brief as advertisers/brief. Never 404s; a domain Upspring cannot source answers status unavailable and is not charged.
To confirm a board token exists on Greenhouse and read the employer's name and blurb before listing its openings with jobs or search.
To discover department ids for search or to see how openings spread across departments.
When you have a job post id from jobs or search, or a pasted job page URL, and need the description, departments or application questions.

Start here with a board token to enumerate every opening with id, title, location, requisition id, dates and the public job URL. Pass next_page back as page. Use search for the board's own server-side keyword, department and office filters, and job for descriptions and application questions.
To discover office ids for search or to see where an employer is hiring.

When you need Greenhouse's own keyword search or a department/office filter, or the department of each post. Ids for department_id and office_id come from this function's departments/offices lists or from the departments and offices functions.
